newsitem.title: USA: Sun Coast's Smiley to resign from board.
newsitem.headline: Sun Coast's Smiley to resign from board.

text.p: Sun Coast Industries Inc said on Friday that Stephen Smiley will resign from its board of directors on June 30 because of time constraints with other business commitments.
Smiley served as chairman of Sun Coast's board of directors from September 1992 through April 1996. He is currently president of Hunt Financial Corp, a private investment firm in Dallas.

Sun Coast, a plastic products manufacturer, also said it had elected Wayne Kern as a new board member effective June 2. Kern has served as senior vice president and secretary of Heritage Media Corp since 1987.
